There are plenty of expensive ways to get better at Procurement.

Expensive courses and Qualifications. 



But after 25+ years in both direct and indirect procurement roles, I figured out the real differentiator for procurement success - and it doesn’t cost the earth.



It’s how you interact with others.

Your ability to influence, communicate, and collaborate.

In short, your soft skills.



I’m Tom Mills, Procurement Protagonist®, and through years of hard-won experience (and a few battle scars), I built the frameworks that helped me and my teams thrive. 



Those frameworks became my flagship course, Procurement Soft Skills Mastery, now helping procurement professionals elevate their careers around the world.



I also simplify procurement through cheat sheets, frameworks, and my weekly newsletter, Procure Bites -- - read by over 20,000 procurement pros who want real, relatable insights (not jargon).



Here’s how I can help you:



1. Subscribe to Procure Bites - the number one independent procurement newsletter.



2. Join the waitlist for Procurement Soft Skills Mastery (limited enrolment windows).



3. Partner with me through the Quarterly Growth Package if you’re a business looking to reach 130,000+ LinkedIn followers and 24,000+ newsletter subscribers.



All links are in my bio and featured section.



📧 Sponsorship enquiries: tommills@procurebites.com

For more than 20 years at Procter & Gamble, across North America, APAC, and IMEA, I’ve led procurement transformation in large, matrixed organizations—building leadership capability, aligning teams across regions, and shifting procurement from a support function into an integral part of how the business runs.

Operating models where aligned incentives and embedded governance turn suppliers from vendors into value-creating partners.

• 𝗔𝗜-𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀
AI-powered decision flows that shorten time-to-market, simplify partner engagement, and embed risk and governance into everyday business decisions—without slowing execution.

• 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝘅𝗲𝗰𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
Business systems where risk, compliance, and responsibility are embedded into everyday decisions—so teams move faster with confidence, not slower with controls.

𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗜 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗞:
Procurement earns influence when it helps the business make better decisions—faster, at scale, and with confidence. Sustainable results come from designing systems that scale judgment, trust, and accountability across people, partners, and technology.

Outside my operating roles, I write and coach on leadership and system design.
